text:
maya: Heads up — alerts showing GPU pool in us-central1 falling below health threshold but autoscaler didn't evict/shift. Prom scrape returns empty for node_gpu_ metrics.

infra-bot: Alert: GPU_Pool_Health(us-central1) degraded. Ticket #INC-1029 created.

santiago: how long has this been? any recent changes to scraping or network taps?

maya: started ~10:12 UTC. We rolled a fluentd filter to drop noisy node logs 20:50 yesterday but that shouldn't affect prometheus scraping.

liam: I rolled a config change to the network tap yesterday to reduce sample rate — checking if tap is dropping telemetry.

nisha: fluentd change only touched logs; otel/metrics pipeline was on a different rollout yesterday morning (no changes).

maya: curl http://10.4.1.9:9100/metrics -> 200 but body missing lines starting with node_gpu_. kubelet logs show '504 upstream read timeout' to scrape proxy.

santiago: so metrics proxy between prometheus and nodes timing out. Any gateway restarts? traces?

oncall-ops: noticed gateway pod restart loop around 10:10 due to transient mem spike. otel traces missing for that window.

liam: confirming — tap relay was switched to sidecar-relay and I lowered max_conns to reduce load. relay hit max_conns and started returning 504s.

maya: Autoscaler relies on prom metrics for 'gpu_utilization' — if no metric => no scale decision. we effectively sat on depleted capacity. need fallback to kube metrics.

santiago: agree. short-term: shift production traffic off us-central1 to us-west1 manually? we'll pay egress and higher latency.

nisha: :warning: shifting will increase cross-region egress and latency. rough cost estimate +3x token-processing cost for affected requests.

maya: propose quick fixes: 1) increase relay max_conns, 2) restart gateway once with backoff, 3) enable prometheus scrape fallback to node/cadvisor metrics, 4) add synthetic 'last_scrape_timestamp' metric and alert on age.

santiago: do it. liam can you patch relay? oncall-ops can you coordinate restart window?

liam: patching relay now. will push config in 2 mins.

deploy-bot: deploy started by liam. rollout id relay-2026-03-18-1. 3 pods targeted.

deploy-bot: rollout success.

liam: rolled. relays now returning 200 for /metrics proxy requests and passing through node_gpu_ metrics.

maya: prometheus scraping resumed, node_gpu_* returned. autoscaler caught up and triggered 2 scale-ups. traffic stable.

santiago: follow-ups: 1) alert on 'last_scrape_age > 30s', 2) runbook update for relay max_conns and autoscaler fallback, 3) postmortem (include cost delta).

nisha: :thumbsup: I'll draft runbook. also let's add a synthetic canary that hits full telemetry path (relay -> gateway -> prometheus).

maya: I'll open the postmortem and include cost delta numbers + timeline.

yorick: we saw ~4% traffic rerouted for 12 mins; cost impact estimated +$1.8k.

maya: adding followup tasks: jira INFOPS-439 add metric last_scrape_timestamp, INFOPS-440 runbook update, INFOPS-441 canary job.

maya: closing thread if no objections. :white_check_mark:
